v052.launcherTip: Opens TmForeverLauncher.exe with its settings first. A TMLoader profile always starts through TMLoader.
v052.dxvk.adminNote: The game folder needs admin rights. Windows asks once; only d3d9.dll and dxvk.conf are copied.
perf.dxvk.err.needAdmin: The game folder needs admin rights.
perf.dxvk.err.verify: The copy could not be verified. Switch DXVK off to remove what arrived.
perf.dxvk.err.failed: The step with admin rights failed. Nothing changed.
perf.dxvk.err.elevate: Windows could not ask for admin rights.
v052.sync.title: Cpu/Gpu synchro
v052.sync.tip: 1 Frame: more FPS with shaders, one frame more input delay. Immediate (default): the CPU waits for the GPU every frame.
v052.sync.shared: Nations and United Forever share this setting.
v052.sync.readOnly: Change it in the game's launcher under Advanced.
v052.sync.notWritable: The game folder needs admin rights. Change it in the game's launcher under Advanced.
v052.smoothing: Smoothing switches (Timer 1 ms and more) are in the game: Insert > Horizon Performance > Smoothing.
v052.skid.gameClean: Clean (game folder): already set in the game folder, nothing to do.
v052.skid.gameCustom: Changed in the game folder (another texture).
v052.skid.tmlRedundant: The TMLoader product Skid Marks is not needed.
v052.skid.adminTip: Windows asks for admin rights once.
v052.syncTip.title: More FPS: Cpu/Gpu synchro 1 Frame
v052.syncTip.text: The game waits for the GPU after every frame (Immediate). With shaders, 1 Frame gives much more FPS.
v052.syncTip.tip: About one frame more input delay.
v052.syncTip.where: In the game's launcher: Advanced > Cpu/Gpu synchro > 1 Frame.
v052.syncTip.done: Cpu/Gpu synchro is now 1 Frame. It counts from the next game start.
